name: @artoo/desktop
description: artoo desktop shell (Electron spike, #30): wraps the web reference UI, connects to a configurable server, with seams for #28 device pairing and #29 local artood supervision. Not the full desktop product.
author: artoo
comment:build-deps: electron + electron-builder are intentionally NOT in the workspace deps so the monorepo's default install/verify stays light. Install them ad-hoc to build the desktop shell: `npm i -D electron@33.4.11 electron-builder@25 -w @artoo/desktop`. See README.md.
